_note: V5.3 a, the plant-closure rule (docs/design/v5.3-ab.md 3.2, src/sim/closures.gd). STAND-INS written by Systems so the rule can be measured; Content authors the numbers (the spec's section 10), as data, never per firm. window_months: the months over which a major's output fall is measured. fall: the fraction of its output a major must lose over the window for its sector to announce a closure. cut: the share of the picked firm's live share, so of its jobs, a landed closure removes (a plant, not the firm). cooldown_months: the months after a closure ends before the same SECTOR may announce again (at least window + the answer's months, so a landed closure's own cut never re-announces). bloc_offset: what a landed closure of reference_jobs moves; a plant moves it in proportion to its jobs. V5.3 majors (the parent's ruling): the rule fires per sector, one major picked by its share of the sector's jobs, so adding real majors does not change the calibrated rate; per major, FRA went from 14 closures a decade to 39. reference_jobs is about the mean plant at the real majors' shares (tools/closure_rate_probe.gd), so the mean closure moves #251's -0.02. THE RATE (the author's call on #286): a major past `fall` is nearly always there, so the rule is a chance, not a timer. monthly_chance: a falling sector's chance of a closure in a month, at reference_fall and with the economy at its potential. reference_fall: the worst major's fall that reads as 1. gap_slope: how much each point of output gap below potential adds, and each point above takes away. cooldown_months is only a floor now. STAND-INS by Systems, the mean set across six seeds to the base economy's targets (FRA 14, DEU 11, GBR 14, POL 15 a decade; tools/closure_rate_probe.gd), for the author's table. V5.3 PR 3 (the author's call 3, 2026-11-14: closures FEWER AND LARGER, thousands of jobs): cut 0.03 -> 0.08 and monthly_chance 0.18 -> 0.05, so FRA reads 6 a decade at a mean plant of 6 700 jobs (was 17 at 2 350; the jobs lost a decade about the same), DEU 10 at 7 100, GBR 6 at 3 000, POL 7 at 2 500 (tools/closure_rate_probe.gd, one run each). reference_jobs 2500 -> 6700, the new mean plant, by this note's own rule (the mean closure moves #251's -0.02): left at 2500, one large plant moved the workers bloc by -0.054 at once and the acts' share of their offset passed test_balance's 0.50 cap in five runs.
